objective: expose the unchanged persistent typed planner plus exact event-driven invalidation path to one bounded natural MAP01 threat sequence
seed_basis: the retained v23 run at this seed contained independently reviewable visible enemies, health loss and stale threat-cover repetition; model and transport now differ

environment.app_server: Codex Desktop 0.153.4 Windows via WSL stdio
environment.preflight: model-free initialize returned codexHome/platformFamily/platformOs/userAgent and zero model turns

guard.authority: cancel matching planner turn and current cover; discard dependent action and next_cover; grant no input

stop_rule: retain first run at 12 decisions, death, model terminal state, runtime failure or independent episode end; no retry of this allocation
threat_exposure_rule: classify as threat-exposed only when a retained exact source or temporal frame is independently inspected and visibly contains an enemy; model assessment, damage or kill count alone is insufficient
natural_invalidation_acceptance: guard outcome comes from an exact advancing runtime observation with no injection
the matching planner turn receives at most one interrupt and reaches an ineligible terminal result
the active cover reaches a terminal with verified empty key/button release
the invalidated model action and its next_cover admit zero input and supply no following cover
a later fresh decision can complete on the persistent app-server process
normal_path_acceptance: every started planner turn reaches one matching terminal; every admitted cover and plan reaches verified terminal release; usage missingness remains explicit
no_exposure_disposition: retain as natural-threat or invalidation unexposed and do not retry this ID
failure_disposition: retain exact failure and diagnose before any differently versioned run
comparison_limit: same MAP01 seed as retained v23 but a different model and planner transport, sequential execution and nondeterministic authored actions; report mechanics and descriptive outcomes only
scope: one bounded Linux/X11 natural-threat allocation; no causal survival, reliability, generality, human-speed, Product Hunt completion or MAP01-clear claim
